comment: Positions, ranges and normalling read from src/PalmLoop.cpp at tag 2.0.1, the installed version. The octave figure comes from the pitch sum in process(): the knob value plus 0.031360 octaves, so the default 8 gives 2^8.03136Hz, C4 at 261.63Hz. The square and triangle run at half the sawtooth frequency because the sign flip happens once per phase wrap; the sub sine is built from half the phase, so it is an octave down as well. Linear FM is only summed when the LIN FM jack is connected, and the phase increment is then clamped to one sample period either way.
